## BREAKING CHANGES

- `createRouter()` no longer accepts a `basename` string; pass `{ basename }` instead.

## Features

- Added `useBlocker` hook.

### Changes

- Removed the `timeoutMs` option. Requests now use the global `timeout` setting.
- Improved retry logging.

note: Dropping a runtime version breaks anyone still on it.
body:
- Node.js 18 is no longer supported. The minimum is now Node.js 20.
- Faster startup by lazy-loading commands.

note: A changed default silently changes behaviour on upgrade.
body:
- Responses are no longer cached by default. Set `cache: true` to restore the previous behaviour.
- New `stale-while-revalidate` support.

### Fixes

- Fixed decimal precision in MySQL.
- Fixed `limit` with `offset` on SQLite.
- `findMany` now returns `[]` instead of `null` when nothing matches.
- Fixed a typo in an error message.
- Faster schema introspection.
